title: Military reinforcements move to Mideast. And, millions of Americans vote early
description: Military reinforcements are heading to the Middle East and some personnel have left the region, pointing to a potential attack on Iran. And, millions of Americans have already voted in the midterms.

title: Trump's midterm campaign tour stops in Iowa
description: Republicans are facing a tough fight in Iowa. President Trump's campaign tour stopped in the state in hopes of rallying voters.

title: Gen Z is 'in the thick' of high housing costs. These candidates aim to solve it
description: Young candidates who rent or live with parents say their generation is "in the thick" of the country's housing affordability crisis. They argue this gives them new energy to solve it for everyone.

title: Trump must sit for a deposition in his BBC defamation lawsuit, judge rules
description: A magistrate judge orders President Trump to sit for a deposition in a case he's brought against the BBC for defamation.

title: Trump's attacks on the press have become a war
description: The New York Times reported that the Trump Administration is considering physically moving the White House press corps out of the White House.

title: Federal judge restricts DHS field operations looking for noncitizen voters
description: The judge found the department's field operations to identify noncitizens who voted likely violated the Voting Rights Act, which bars voter intimidation.

title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
description: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
description: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

title: Trump's redistricting gave Republicans a head start, now it goes to the voters
description: President Trump, seeking to reshape the voting map, prompted a rare wave of mid-decade redistricting that gave Republicans a boost for holding the House. But the voters will determine if it works.

title: Farm country has beef with Trump as midterms approach
description: President Trump's attempts to bring beef prices down has potentially backfired politically in several key states.
